title: RAEv2 extremal symmetric-Jacobian curvature audit
aggregation: Independent CPU parse of original CSV/JSON; unweighted arithmetic sample means, n=4 in each domain/time group; all 40 rows and all 120 Krylov checkpoints retained.

definitions.rho_F: v^T H_F v with unit final Full Ritz vector v, independently reevaluated
definitions.rho_B: v^T H_B v on the same Full vector
definitions.rho_IG: rho_F+0.78*(rho_F-rho_B), official IG 1.78, all audited t in [0.1,1]
definitions.gap_cosine: v^T(F-B)/||F-B||; reported absolute value because eigenvector sign is arbitrary
definitions.direct_residual: ||H_F*v-rho_F*v|| from a new final Full JVP/VJP evaluation
definitions.dataward_drift: tau=1-t; b=(F-z)/t; sym(J_b)=(H_F+t*I)/[(1-t)*t]; expansion threshold rho_F>-t

request.start: independent isotropic Gaussian, seed 202609081+sample_id; reused across times/domains
request.precision: FP32 parameters/states/JVP/VJP; FP64 Krylov basis/reductions; no autocast/TF32; math SDPA
request.interpretation: positive measured Rayleigh certifies a numerically observed expansion direction; negative largest Ritz value is NOT proof of a negative full spectrum
request.nonconservative_boundary: H_F is a symmetric Jacobian diagnostic; no assertion that F is the score of its endpoint law
request.drift_relation: for dataward clock tau=1-t, b=(F-z)/t, sym(J_b)=(H_F+t*I)/((1-t)*t); drift expansion threshold is rho>-t, not rho>0
request.finite_difference: first fixed state only; central steps h=sqrt(d)*[0.001,0.0003,0.0001,0.00003] on the final unit Ritz direction; all retained
request.numerical_refinement_reason: K8 smoke showed 26%/10% full-JVP finite-difference relative error at RMS 0.001/0.0003, requiring smaller diagnostic perturbations; this does not tune a guidance method

summary_from_run.boundary: Limited saved-state FP32 local expansion diagnostic; no model-error, density, saddle or quality conclusion.

source_state_and_model_hashes: Copied verbatim from original request; large checkpoint and input-state files were not rehashed for archival aggregation.
limitations: 40 frozen-state rows are 4 samples/classes at 5 times in 2 domains; correlated repeated measurements from the previous normal-noise bank, not 40 independent confirmations.
Full positive direct Rayleigh values identify numerically observed positive directions of H_F. Random negative directions and previous gap/random/normal probes do not exclude such directions.
Largest Ritz values are lower bounds on the largest eigenvalue in exact arithmetic, not upper bounds; a single start and K=24 do not characterize the whole spectrum or positive eigenspace.
Base and IG quadratic forms are evaluated on the final Full Ritz vector, not their separately optimized eigenvectors.
Absolute cosine with one Full Ritz direction is not the norm of the guidance gap projected onto the entire positive eigenspace.
Ratio uses ||(1-t)(J_F-J_F^T)v/2|| / ||H_F v||, including the minus-I shift in the denominator; it is not a full-matrix skew/symmetric norm ratio.
Finite-difference relative error compares the Full JVP, not H_F v. Formal teacher sample 0 K24 direction differs from smoke rollout sample 0 K8 direction.
Positive rho is distinct from dataward drift expansion threshold rho > -t. The actual network need not equal a true posterior mean or a conservative score.
No true-density saddle, model-error, suppression benefit, global spectrum, new guidance method or FID conclusion follows.
FP32 math-SDPA derivative diagnostics differ from saved BF16 trajectory numerics; all four formal FD steps are retained, including coarse-step failures.
Smoke finite-difference errors motivated smaller numerical diagnostic perturbations, not adjustment of guidance parameters.
No GPU rerun, sampling, decoding, training, or new tests were performed for this archival aggregation.
